mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing partly cloudy skies at 82 degrees, though it feels like 85 down at Fireman's Park. Tonight will bring a beautiful waxing crescent moon and a great view of the International Space Station, passing overhead for five minutes starting at 10:19 PM.

In city news, Verona is highlighting green initiatives. Apartment residents can compost by dropping off food scraps at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city is offering residential rebates for rain barrels to prevent yard flooding and low-flow toilets to help conserve water.

Looking at our calendar, Saturday, July 18th is packed with events like the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Square, the Mount Horeb Art Fair, and live music at Lake Louie. Down the road, mark your calendar for the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday, July 22nd.

In police news, last Thursday, July 9th, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash with minor injuries at County Highway PB and American Way, where a 16-year-old driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way to a 74-year-old woman during a left turn.

Finally, wrap up your day with a sweet treat at Culver's. Today's Flavor of the Day is Mint Cookie, a perfect blend of cool mint and chocolate crunch. They are open until 10:30 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by. Tomorrow's flavor will be Turtle.
